Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer failed to extract and report relevant burial details from the Find a Grave page, which was visible in the initial viewport during the first web search. The page contained specific information about Waylon Jennings’ burial location (City of Mesa Cemetery, Mesa, Arizona), but WebSurfer did not process or summarize this information effectively. This omission led to unnecessary repeated searches and instructions from the Planner, delaying the resolution of the task.
